entries.title: Find jobs from a machine or customer
entries.description: Open the new Jobs tab on a machine or customer to see related jobs, newest first, filter by stage, and open a job directly. Unsaved details stay intact when switching tabs.

entries.title: Filter machine history by date
entries.description: Use the date range filter in the History table’s When column to focus on the period you need.

entries.title: Find report and farm controls in their headers
entries.description: Choose the reporting period from the Reports header, and add a farm using New farm in the Farms header.
